{{Short description|German physicist (1941–2023)}}
[[File:Professor-Gerhard-Kraft.jpg|thumb|Kraft in 2016]]
'''Gerhard Kraft''' (29 October 1941 – 18 March 2023) was a German physicist, best known for introducing [[Heavy_ion_therapy#Heavy_ion_therapy|heavy ion cancer therapy]] in Europe. 

He was the founder and director of the Biophysics Department at the [[GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research]] in [[Darmstadt]] (Germany).<ref name="GSI 2023 f044">{{cite web | title=Prof. Dr. Gerhard Kraft | website=GSI | date=22 March 2023 | url=https://www.gsi.de//work/forschung/biophysik/prof-dr-gerhard-kraft | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref> Particle therapy had already been performed in US and Japan using [[protons]], carbon, and other light [[ions]]. Gerhard Kraft introduced it in Europe, with two significant innovations: [[raster scanning]] and biological treatment planning. Under his direction, 440 patients were treated from 1997 to 2008 at GSI.<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" /> Therapy now continues at the {{ill|Heidelberger Ionenstrahl-Therapiezentrum|de}} using the system introduced at GSI.<ref name="GSI 2023 f044" />

== Biography ==
Gerhard Kraft was born on 29 October 1941 in [[Heidelberg]].<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" /> He studied Physics in Heidelberg and Cologne.<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" /> Kraft got his PhD at the [[University of Cologne]] with a study of energy loss of carbon ions in matter.<ref name="Echo Online 2023 q902">{{cite web | title=Trauer in Darmstadt um einen Pionier der Schwerionentherapie | website=Echo Online | date=6 April 2023 | url=https://www.echo-online.de/lokales/darmstadt/trauer-in-darmstadt-um-einen-pionier-der-schwerionentherapie-2450658 | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref> After a two year fellowship at the [[Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory]] (Berkeley, CA, US)<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" /> under the supervision of Cornelius A. Tobias, he went back to Germany with the idea of using high-energy carbon ions to cure cancer.<ref name="Durante Debus 2018 pp. 160–167">{{cite journal | last1=Durante | first1=Marco | last2=Debus | first2=Jürgen | title=Heavy Charged Particles: Does Improved Precision and Higher Biological Effectiveness Translate to Better Outcome in Patients? | journal=Seminars in Radiation Oncology | publisher=Elsevier BV | volume=28 | issue=2 | year=2018 | issn=1053-4296 | doi=10.1016/j.semradonc.2017.11.004 | pages=160–167}}</ref> Since 1981 he started his work on heavy-ion [[radiobiology]] and [[radiotherapy]] at GSI, and the treatment room was completed in 1997.<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" /> The last patient was treated in 2008.<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" /> Kraft died on 18 March 2023 in Heidelberg.<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" />

== Awards ==

Kraft received many awards over his career, some of which are listed below:

* 1993 Honorary professor at the [[University of Kassel]]<ref name="Informationsdienst Wissenschaft – Nachrichten 2000 z091">{{cite web | title=Erwin-Schrödinger-Preisträger ist auch GhK-Honorarprofessor | website=Informationsdienst Wissenschaft – Nachrichten | date=12 January 2000 | url=https://idw-online.de/mobile/de/news17038 | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref>
* 1999 [[Erwin Schrödinger]] Award, Helmholtz Association<ref name="GSI 2023 r897">{{cite web | title=Pionier der Schwerionentherapie verstorben: Trauer um Biophysiker Gerhard Kraft | website=GSI | date=24 March 2023 | url=https://www.gsi.de/start/aktuelles/detailseite/2023/03/24/gerhard-kraft | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref><ref name="Stifterverband k966">{{cite web | title=Erwin-Schrödinger-Preis | website=Stifterverband | url=https://www.stifterverband.org/schroedinger-preis | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref>
* 2000 [[Otto Hahn Prize|Otto Hahn Prize of the City of Frankfurt am Main]]<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" />
* 2006 Bacq & Alexander Award, European Radiation Research Society<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" />
* 2006 Ulrich Hagen Award, German Society for Radiation Research<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" />
* 2008 Officer's Cross of the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]]<ref name="GSI 2023 r897" />
* 2008–2011 Helmholtz Honorary Professor<ref>{{cite journal | last=Mau | first=Jens | title=Gerhard Kraft: Der Unnachgiebige | journal=Kma – Klinik Management Aktuell | publisher=Georg Thieme Verlag KG | volume=15 | issue=6 | year=2010 | issn=1439-3514 | doi=10.1055/s-0036-1575647 | pages=70–73 | s2cid=98928374 | language=de}}</ref>
* 2009 Ph.D. h.c., [[University of Giessen]]<ref name="Informationsdienst Wissenschaft - Nachrichten 2008 q382">{{cite web | title=Ehrendoktorwürde für Verdienste in der Krebsforschung an Prof. Gerhard Kraft | website=Informationsdienst Wissenschaft – Nachrichten | date=12 December 2008 | url=https://idw-online.de/de/news?id=293671 | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref>
* 2013 Honorary member of Particle Therapy Co-Operative Group (PTCOG)<ref>[https://www.ptcog.ch/archive/steering_committee_docs/ptcog52/PTCOG52_General_Assembly_Report_2013.pdf PTCOG52 General Assembly Report 2013]</ref>
* 2015 Honorary member of {{ill|Deutsche Gesellschaft für medizinische Physik|de}} (DGMP)<ref name="GSI 2015 z394">{{cite web | title=Press | website=GSI | date=13 November 2015 | url=https://www.gsi.de//en/work/research/biophysics/press | access-date=14 July 2023}}</ref>
* 2018–2021 Honorary President of European Radiation Research Society<ref name="ERRS Home 1959 r609">{{cite web | title=EUROPEAN RADIATION RESEARCH SOCIETY | website=ERRS Home | date=5 November 1959 | url=https://www.errs.eu/errs_history.htm | language=de | access-date=14 July 2023 | archive-date=12 January 2022 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220112194709/https://www.errs.eu/ERRS_history.htm | url-status=dead }}</ref>
